q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of aluminium sheet per tonne?
title: Aluminium sheet carbon footprint per tonne
short: Most of the footprint is in the metal: multiply the ingot, slab or scrap per tonne of sheet by the supplier's figure. Add remelting, hot and cold rolling and annealing energy, then divide the mill's energy by tonnes dispatched.
audience: Aluminium rolling mills and sheet buyers

ul: Primary ingot or slab, or scrap, by weight.
Edge trim and process scrap remelted.
Remelting and casting furnaces, if used.

p: Report per tonne with the recycled share. Primary aluminium made with coal power carries a much higher figure than recycled metal, so name the source.

example.title: Worked example: aluminium sheet unit per tonne (one month)
lines: Plant total: 407,000 / 1,000 = 407.0 kg CO2 per tonne
Add metal for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
